definition: [ לָעַז ] verb talk indistinctly, unintelligibly (Late Hebrew id. , in derivatives ( לַעַז foreign language , לָעוּז foreigner ), also murmur, remonstrate ; Syriac talk indistinctly ; Arabic distort ; IV. talk obscurely, ambiguously ); — only Qal Participle עַם לֹעֵז Ps 114:1 a people talking unintelligibly (|| מִצְרַיִם ).
